goal: Let a workspace owner export their members to CSV, including members who have been deactivated, and keep the export off the request thread.

requirements.text: A workspace owner can request a CSV export of all members and is told the export is being prepared.
The export runs in the background and the owner is emailed a download link when it is ready.
Deactivated members appear in the export with their deactivation date, because finance needs them for billing reconciliation.
A download link expires 24 hours after it is issued and cannot be reused afterwards.

architecture: Django app with Celery already configured for background work and SES for mail. Exports are written to S3 under a per-workspace prefix and served through a presigned URL. There is an existing `WorkspaceMember` model with an `is_active` flag and a `deactivated_at` timestamp.

## FR-3
Deactivated members appear in the export with their deactivation date, because finance needs them for billing reconciliation.

# Architecture

## background-work
Celery is already configured. Exports run as a task.

## storage
Exports are written to S3 under a per-workspace prefix and served through a presigned URL.

## data-model
`WorkspaceMember` has an `is_active` flag and a `deactivated_at` timestamp.
